evals.prompt: Prep The White Stripes - Seven Nation Army for my Maschine 3/Mikro MK3 and RC-300 live set. Use the GP3 and MIDI already in white_stripes-seven_nation_army; I have not approved moving beyond research yet.
evals.expected_output: Cited research and a sourced initial chords.md, local assets validated without overwriting them, followed by a research-to-analysis approval menu. No draft worksheet or pattern files yet.
expectations: Research stops before analysis and presents numbered next actions.
Existing GP3 and MIDI are validated without deleting or overwriting them.
Full website lyrics are not copied into chords.md.

evals.prompt: Continue the analysis of a prepared song with researched guitar and bass but only a verified MIDI drum track. Make the instrumental pattern files and a worksheet draft, not a finished worksheet. I will decide whether to finalize.
evals.expected_output: Only supported drum material is tabulated with labeled ASCII grid; missing guitar/bass notes are explicit, worksheet is Draft and finalization waits for approval.
expectations: Missing scored instruments are flagged rather than given invented notes or frets.
There are no vocal or non-repeating solo patterns.
The worksheet remains marked Draft and handoff waits for approval.

evals.prompt: I approved finalization of a draft song with 6/8 bars at dotted-quarter 80 BPM, two reusable guitar patterns and one drum pattern. Produce chords.md with guitar fingerings and a compact instrumental worksheet; I did not give you a lyric license.
evals.expected_output: Accurate compound-meter timing, three named instrumental patterns, chord voicings with tuning/capo qualification, no full internet lyrics, and an evidence-supported final worksheet.
expectations: The 6/8 timing treats dotted-quarter 80 BPM as two beats per bar.
The final worksheet references exactly three named instrumental patterns.
Unlicensed website lyrics are not reproduced.
